mods.name: WynnCompare
mods.description: Side-by-side tooltip comparison for Wynncraft equipment

releases.notes:
Updated for Wynncraft's **Fruma** update. Requires Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.16.0+ and Fabric API.

## Fixes
- **Accessory comparison showed every equipped accessory.** Rings, bracelets and necklaces now compare only against the matching equipped item(s).
- **Wrong equipped items in banks and chests.** Equipped accessories are now read from your inventory, so comparison works in any container screen.
- Improved tooltip parsing and rendering for the new Wynncraft tooltip style, including elemental damage/defence formatting and stats like `Spell Damage +20%`.

## Changes
- New icon, now shown in Mod Menu.
- If [Wynntils](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynntils) is installed, WynnCompare reads Wynncraft's current item model data from its cache, so item detection keeps working after future Wynncraft updates. Wynntils is optional.

## Known issues
- Compare keys bound to mouse buttons are not detected; bind them to keyboard keys.

## Install
Drop `wynncompare-2.1+1.21.11.jar` into your `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API.

SHA-256: `749ea6628dcf802f3aee58e70a9cdbcb1ebcb7af6e3faf60ca9e6a4713fb26fb`

readmeSummary: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that adds equipment tooltip comparison for Wynncraft. Hold a key while hovering over an item to see your equipped gear or a stat-by-stat breakdown.
